name: Minimal iconic

characters.mili: Smallest. Lightning bolts when she moves. Squash and stretch.
characters.sati: Medium sphere, confident brows, the story focus.

camera: Orthographic. Side-on, three-quarter, or a light isometric. Same blocking as the Pixar camera.
light: Flat bands only. Soft disc shadows. No HDRI.
line: Silhouette first. Outlines only where a shape needs them.
materials: Unlit or 3-tone toon. White characters, four to six colors per scene.
notes: Preview toggle: Flat. The world sheet is the board.
